Punong Barangay Barangay Tibagon, Pantukan, Davao de Oro Dear PB Raga: This has reference to your December 7, 2023 letter to this Department seeking guidance regarding the payment deadline for Liga membership dues in relation to the conduct of Liga Municipal/CC/HUC/CC synchronized elections. Your request for guidance stemmed from the issuance of LnB Memorandum Circular Memorandum Circular 2023-001 by the Liga ng mga Barangay National Executive Board. This issuance contains the guidelines for the conduct pf the Liga ng mga Barangay elections. Pertinently, MC 2023-001 states: "H. In the NEB Meeting conducted last II November 2023 at the Sheraton Hotel Manila, the NEB has set the following additional qualifications for the conduct of the elections. a. xxx b. Any representative of a barangay/chapter who fall under the following, shall not be eligible run for office: • FOR PROVINCIAL/HUC/ICC CHAPTER ELECTIONS Representatives of Barangays or Municipal/CC Chapters that did not pay their Liga Dues by the August 31 deadline prescribed by the National Liga. FOR MUNICIPAL/CC CHAPTER ELECTIONS Representatives of barangays who did not pay their Liga Dues by the deadline prescribed by the incumbent Liga President (emphasis ours). " You wish to be clarified on whether the August 31, 2023 deadline for Provincial/HUC/lCC Chapter elections also applies to Municipal/CC Chapter Elections as members of the Nominations Committee in your chapter have different views on the matter. According to you some members of the Nominations Committee are of the view that "Matino, Mahusay at Maaasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

payment of Liga dues by August 31, 2023 should apply even to Municipal and CC Chapter Elections while others believe that the said deadline only applies to Provincial Chapter Elections based on the clear wordings of MC 2023-01. In reply, may we inform you that the question herein proffered for this Service's legal opinion has been rendered moot and academic by the supervening issuance on 12 December 2023 of LnB Memorandum Circular No. 2023-10 officially recalling Memorandum Circulars Nos. 2023-001 and 2023-002. In this connection, the Department has issued an Advisory dated 14 December 2023 entitled "Liga ng mga Barangay Memorandum Circular No. 2023-010 Recalling Memorandum Circulars Nos. 2023-001 and 2023-002". The relevant portion of the Advisory is quoted hereunder. Under Memorandum No. 2023-10, the LnB has removed the requirement for payment of membership dues on or before 31 August 2023 as a prerequisite for patticipation in the chapter elections. Atticle VI relevantly provides: Atticle VI 1. All barangays are required to update the full payment of their 2023 Liga Dues and to sign a promissoty note FORM 9 to pay their 2024 Liga Dues before January IO, 2024 in order to vote in the Municipal/CC/HUC/CC synchronized elections on December 15, 2023. 2. All Liga Chapters are required to remit the full payment of all 2019 to 2024 Liga Dues, 2024 Liga Dues plus full payment of the 2024 Subscription to the Liga National Office Publication in order for the chapters to vote in the Provincial/Regional and National Synchronized Elections. The barangay representative in the LnB chapter elections need only update their membership dues, in accordance with the above provision, before the scheduled We hope to have sufficiently addressed your concems. Thank you. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: ATTY. JUAN VICTOR R. LLAMAS Undersecretary for Extemal, Legal and Legislative Affairs OUSELLA/JVRULLLS-LRALLD/jvpr Copy furnished ALEX C.
